name.ja: HG 1/72 メイレスジョウガン改

description.ja: KEN OKUYAMA DESIGNによる構造検証を経て、ジョウガンの改良機、「ジョウガン改」をHGで立体化！
description.en: After structural verification by KEN OKUYAMA DESIGN, the improved version of Jougan, "Jougan Kai", has been made into a three-dimensional HG model!

description.ja: ■「境界戦機」第二部より、鉄塚ガシンが搭乗。自律思考型AI ケイを移植し、大火力を有する機体に生まれ変わった。
description.en: • From the second part of "Kyoukai Senki", Tetsuzuka Gasin is on board. It has been implanted with the autonomous thinking AI Kei and has been reborn as a machine with great firepower.

description.ja: ■機体正面に向けて大型のガトリング、背部には大型のドラムマガジンを装着、圧倒的な火力で敵を制圧する。
description.en: • A large gatling is attached to the front of the aircraft, and a large drum magazine is attached to the back, suppressing the enemy with overwhelming firepower.

description.ja: ■リアスカートにはガトリングの反動から機体を支える為、バイポットを内蔵。パーツ差替えにより設置状態に展開可能。
description.en: • The rear skirt has a built-in bipot to support the aircraft from the recoil of Gatling. Can be expanded to installed state by replacing parts.

description.ja: ■両肩のシールドはガトリング基部の装甲と連結し、防御力の高い状態を再現。
description.en: • The Seals on both shoulders are connected to the armor at the base of the Gatling to recreate a highly defensive state.

description.ja: ■本体前面の装甲には携行短機関砲２丁を収納可能。
description.en: • Two portable submachine guns can be stored in the armor on the front of the main body.

description.ja: TVアニメ「境界戦機」第二部は４月開始！！第一部のエピソードはBANDAI SPIRITS 公式 YouTubeにて全話無料配信中！
description.en: The second part of the TV anime "Kyoukai Senki" starts in 4! ! All episodes of the first part are available for free on BANDAI SPIRITS official YouTube!

accessories.ja: ハンドパーツ平手（左右）、握り手(左右)、銃持ち手(左右)
accessories.en: Hand parts Open hand (left and right), grip hand (left and right), gun handle (left and right)
